# Neural Network Playground, self-hosted

A copy of the TensorFlow Neural Network Playground, served from
https://course.bioinfo.se/playground/ so that Session 9 does not depend on an outside
site and so that nobody is tracked while using it.

Upstream: <https://github.com/tensorflow/playground>, commit `02469bd3751764b20486015d4202b792af5362a6`.
Copyright 2016 Google Inc., by Daniel Smilkov and Shan Carter.
Licensed under the Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`.

**Do not edit anything in this directory.** It is build output. Run
`tools/builders/build_playground.sh`, which lists the changes we make to
upstream and is the only place to change them.
